items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I had worked with Bob a few days in Mulhouse, France.

ctx.x: A young man named Alesch was also a guest of Felix and he did such things as making trumpets out of cardboard, putting them on long sticks and placing them where the road turn off and on to the lane which went tothe house of Felix, $o that people coming to the party could find the house easily. He also had balloons blown up that came to the number of 68 - years that corresponded my age, and which I sent up to the sky at a certain time. Each balloon had a ticket on it with my address and a statement that I would…

There were quite a number of Swiss jazz musicians that came to the party which got off to an early start that afternoon and finished in the wee hours the next morning. An American bass player named Bob Carter came all the way from where he lived, somewhere in Germany, near Munich. I had worked with Bob a few days in Mulhouse, France. There were at least 8 trumpet players. A few were only amateurs and I had worked with some of them. There was even a violinist and many other instruments. Lily had prepared a lot of…

Felix had a piano in one of his rooms on the first floor. Some musicians started a jam session, but so many musicians came until eventually the piano was moved outside and there was continuous music until the piano was taken back inside around 3 o'clock in the morning. Fortunately, the nearest house to the one of Felix is about 25 yards away, and it's a weekend place for the people that own it. If they were there that night, they must have enjoyed the music, because Felix did not receive any complaints from them,…
